cv.name: Sophie Eastwood
cv.headline: Senior Marketing Manager – FMCG & Food
cv.summary: Marketing leader with eleven years in Australian food and beverage brands. I manage brand portfolios through the full mix, from consumer insight and packaging to retailer activation with Coles and Woolworths, and lead a team of five.

experience.title: Senior Marketing Manager
bullets: Lead marketing for a portfolio of four pantry brands with a A$6M annual budget
Relaunched the core sauce range with new packaging; category share grew 2.3 points in 18 months
Manage the creative and media agencies and the annual brand planning process
Work with sales on retailer joint business plans and in-store activation
Line manager for two brand managers and three coordinators

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Repositioned the mid-price range and launched the cellar door club
Ran trade marketing for liquor retail and on-premise accounts

experience.title: Assistant Brand Manager
bullets: Supported new product launches in the soft drink and water categories
Analysed scan data and prepared monthly brand reports
